title: Esri Unleashes 'Power of Where' Collection to Revolutionize Resource Management
summary: Esri is set to debut its groundbreaking "Power of Where Collection" at the 2026 Esri User Conference, significantly expanding on its seminal 2024 work. This new suite of titles will demonstrate how Geographic Information Systems (GIS) drive superior decision-making, particularly in the critical domains of water and land management, fostering more sustainable and efficient practices globally.
content:
The landscape of environmental and resource management is on the cusp of a major transformation, with spatial intelligence leader Esri poised to introduce its highly anticipated "Power of Where Collection." Set to debut at the 2026 Esri User Conference, this new suite of titles promises to deepen our understanding and application of Geographic Information Systems (GIS), building directly on the profound insights first explored in Jack D.'s 2024 landmark book, *The Power of Where*.

At its core, the collection aims to illuminate the indispensable role GIS plays in confronting some of the planet's most pressing challenges. From managing increasingly scarce water resources to optimizing land use in the face of climate change and rapid urbanization, the ability to make informed, data-driven decisions is paramount. Esri’s initiative is not just about showcasing technology; it’s about providing practical frameworks and tools that empower organizations and governments to navigate complex environmental issues with unprecedented clarity.

These new titles will delve into sophisticated methodologies, illustrating how GIS provides a comprehensive spatial context for critical resource planning. Imagine precision mapping to predict flood zones, monitor drought conditions with satellite accuracy, or strategically plan sustainable agricultural practices. By integrating diverse datasets—from hydrological models to demographic shifts—GIS transforms raw data into actionable intelligence, enabling stakeholders to visualize impacts, forecast outcomes, and implement more effective, long-term solutions for both land and water stewardship.

The 2026 Esri User Conference will serve as the pivotal launchpad for this collection, offering attendees an exclusive first look at its expanded capabilities and real-world applications. As our world continues to grapple with resource strains, Esri's "Power of Where Collection" stands ready to arm decision-makers with the geographic insights necessary to foster resilience, promote efficiency, and ultimately, build a more sustainable future. It's a testament to the enduring power of location in shaping a better tomorrow.
keyTakeaways: Esri will launch its "Power of Where Collection" at the 2026 Esri User Conference.
The collection expands on the 2024 book *The Power of Where*, focusing on advanced GIS applications.
Its core objective is to drive better, data-backed decisions in critical water and land management for global sustainability.
